evidence: ClaudeOwnerRulesAdapter.write maps the typed noCheckout flag to CapabilityUnsupported, so install and update with no checkout are now unsupported and exit 1; the clause text is unchanged.
ClaudeOwnerRulesAdapter.Status uses the typed noCheckout flag in place of strings.HasPrefix on the note.
Uninstall goes through remove(), which this change leaves alone, so it still removes the block when there is no checkout; the new adapter and command tests cover this.
ClaudeAdapter in claude.go discards the new return value, so its output is unchanged.
The diff does not show whether the strings import is still used elsewhere in claude_owner_rules.go after HasPrefix was removed, so I raised no finding on it.
